name: pricing-page
title: Pricing page
description: Pricing: the head with the one dark call to action, each group of prices (pricing table), Enterprise as the page's one red block with what its terms cover, the questions and the closing band.
never: A second red block: Enterprise is the one
Prices hidden behind a contact form, except Enterprise
body: Built on `site-page`: `header`, `footer` and `announcement` are its props, and the `logo` and `actions` slots go to the header (`sheet-actions` too, in web components). Each of `groups` is one `pricing-table`; its `key` is the anchor. Leave out `enterprise` and the red block goes with it.
